programs.title: The Take Down
programs.desc: When Jack, a hit man from London, gets given his life back and the opportunity to save his daughter, it becomes a race against time to kill or be killed.

programs.title: The Lease
programs.desc: Hoping for a fresh start, Julia, a troubled woman, moves to Los Angeles with her new boyfriend. After settling into a new home, mysterious things begin to happen. It's not long before Julia becomes convinced that her demons have moved with her.

programs.title: The Landlord
programs.desc: Alyssa moves into a luxury apartment complex but is unaware she is being watched by her disturbed landlord, Robert, via hidden cameras. Robert will do anything to fill the void left by his estranged daughter--even if that means replacing her.

programs.title: Flight 192
programs.desc: An FBI agent has her family taken hostage while she is on a flight to Washington DC. The agent then has to make a decision that could cost the lives of her husband and her son.
